blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The remarks of Senator Rodante Marcoleta will be presented as evidence in the Sandiganbayan 1st Division trial of one of his three “gift” cases. This was according to the prosecutors on Tuesday. Marcoleta and his co-accused, businessman Aristotle Viray, are facing charges for alleged violations of Presidential Decree (PD) No. 46, which prohibits government officials from receiving, and private individuals from giving, gifts. READ: NET25 host excused from testifying vs Marcoleta, cites religious grounds The senator faces three counts under PD No. 46 over the alleged P75 million in donations he received while serving as a party-list lawmaker.
